title: Storing Multi-valued Collections as Entities (Wasted Joins)
pattern: Mapping collections of simple Value Objects (like strings or integers) to distinct database tables with individual primary keys.
why_bad: It forces unnecessary table joins and triggers ORM database calls for simple attributes, degrading retrieval and storage performance.
detection: Database schema declaring a one-to-many join table for simple primitives or attributes that carry no conceptual business identity.
counterexample: A database table representing a first-class business Entity with its own unique identity and lifecycle.
fix: Serialize the collection of values into a single column (e.g., as a comma-separated string, JSON, or postgres array).
